name: rss-reader
description: RSS 2.0, RSS 1.0, Atom and JSON Feed: fetch from public https URLs (size-capped) or parse given text into normalised items, with since and item limits; no DTDs or entity expansion

nodes.title: Read a feed
nodes.description: Fetches an RSS 2.0, RSS 1.0, Atom or JSON Feed from a public https URL and returns the feed and its items in one normalised shape (title, link, dates, author, categories, plain-text summary, enclosures)

max_items.description: Most items to return, in feed order; `truncated` says when there were more

since.description: ISO 8601 date-time: keep only items published (or updated) after it; undated items are kept

include_content.description: Add each item's full content (content:encoded, Atom content, content_html/text)

content_format.description: Content as readable plain text or as the feed's HTML (not sanitised)

max_content_chars.description: Longest content per item; longer content ends in … and has content_truncated

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Parse feed text
nodes.description: Parses RSS, Atom or JSON Feed text you already have (e.g. from another node) into the same normalised shape as read_feed, without any network access

content.description: The feed document (XML or JSON text)

max_items.description: Most items to return, in feed order; `truncated` says when there were more

since.description: ISO 8601 date-time: keep only items published (or updated) after it; undated items are kept

include_content.description: Add each item's full content (content:encoded, Atom content, content_html/text)

content_format.description: Content as readable plain text or as the feed's HTML (not sanitised)

max_content_chars.description: Longest content per item; longer content ends in … and has content_truncated

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none
